name: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
summary: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and zero runtime hooks, while bounding per-layer normalization drift and preserving n
